item.title: Village votes to leave U.K. in asylum seeker protest
item.description: Piddington residents backed leaving the U.K. in a symbolic vote over nearby asylum housing plans.

item.title: Judge requires 30-day notice before Kennedy Center demolition

item.title: Carney says Canada and Europe stronger together amid US dispute

item.description: Paying less than the minimum may feel better than nothing, but it carries consequences.
